qs.q: A 50-year-old man with insulin-treated diabetes and a history of cerebrovascular disease is being assessed via the Revised Cardiac Risk Index (Lee score) prior to a high-risk vascular procedure. Which additional clinical feature contributes a point toward his index score?
qs.e: The Revised Cardiac Risk Index includes high-risk surgery, ischemic heart disease, heart failure, cerebrovascular disease, insulin-treated diabetes, and a serum creatinine over 177 micromol/L. Obesity and hypertension are not independent variables in the Lee index.
